scope: Exploratory coverage-by-context comparison; no canonical comparison-complete or replacement claim.

design.initialization: Joint training from the same identity affine path and zero-output added path; no frozen memorized affine base.
design.selection: Earliest maximum of the unweighted Alpaca/Pile accuracy mean on the reused common TRR-0004 public validation panel. All arms share data roles and selection opportunities. Freeze the best positionwise arm per distribution using this public metric before fresh evaluation.
design.context_intervention: Train the same attention architecture with a diagonal-only mask; Q/K gradients are zero with one allowed key and effective capacity is therefore disclosed. H_i already contains contextual information. The intervention tests additional earlier activation vectors.
design.corpus_interpretation: The enriched bank changes public token coverage, contexts, and domain mix at fixed fitting-position and record counts; it is not a vocabulary-only causal experiment.

fresh_evaluation.selection_timing: Only after method states, constants, and choices are frozen; source ranges are reserved in advance and excluded from training-frequency analysis.
fresh_evaluation.exclusions: Known opened public evaluation/development records, fitting/selection sources, duplicate source identities, and duplicate final token sequences. Do not inspect prior evaluator-private truth to assemble exclusions.
fresh_evaluation.reporting: Report every domain and target separately. Do not pool domains or treat paired targets as independent sources. Exact recovery refers to the declared 128-token input record, not the full original public document.
fresh_evaluation.truth_gate: All 8 methods x 4 cells and their measured timing evidence must be complete, bound, immutable, and frozen before evaluation truth is opened. No refitting, routing, or output revision after opening truth.

timing.repeat_integrity: Require warmup and measured predicted IDs to match.
timing.boundary: CPU activation through preprocessing and method execution to predicted IDs on CPU; report startup, full process intervals, I/O and synchronization separately.
timing.contention: Exclusive comparative measurement window; no concurrent model, training, tensor-hashing, or test workload.

fresh_evaluation.candidate_exports: A2 may omit stored candidate arrays as an output-only adaptation. Its proposal/selection rule, internal candidate computation, prefix calls, and simulation counts must remain unchanged and be reported.

practical_margins.cost_interpretation: These are decision margins, not fitted method parameters. Crossing a cost budget requires an explicit quality justification; near-identical runtime estimates do not establish architectural speed gains. Report retained state and shared embedding/output-table footprint without a readout-compaction experiment.

uncertainty.resampling_unit: Source record within domain; use the same source resample for both target conditions and all methods.
uncertainty.descriptive_intervals: Paired 95% record-bootstrap intervals for token and exact differences, plus gains and regressions. Do not treat a zero-discordance bootstrap interval as proof of no exact-record benefit.
uncertainty.practical_exclusion_family: At most 16 endpoints: two frozen contrasts x two domains x two targets x token/exact outcomes. Use familywise alpha 0.05 for upper practical-benefit bounds.
uncertainty.token_upper_bound: Paired source-bootstrap quantile 1 - 0.05/16; an exploratory bootstrap bound, not a finite-sample exact guarantee.
uncertainty.exact_upper_bound: Conservative upper bound U(p_gain) - L(p_loss), using one-sided Clopper-Pearson marginal bounds with tail alpha 0.05/32. A gain/loss is an exact-record discordance between the two methods on the same source under the same target. This retains a nonzero bound when no gains are observed.
uncertainty.reason_for_128_sources: With zero observed beneficial discordances and no losses, the conservative exact upper bound is 1 - (0.05/32)^(1/128), approximately 4.93 percentage points; a 16-record panel cannot exclude the planned 5-point benefit.

decision_rules.candidate_useful_effect: The point estimate reaches a practical margin and costs are acceptable; uncertainty still determines strength of evidence.
decision_rules.supported_useful_effect: The paired uncertainty bound supports an improvement of practical size, without a material regression in the other domain or exact-record quality. Report domain/target exceptions explicitly.
decision_rules.prioritize_positionwise: Enrichment improves positionwise quality, and upper bounds exclude the planned token AND exact extra-context margins in every enriched primary domain/target contrast, with acceptable cost.
decision_rules.retain_context: Additional earlier activations retain a useful gain under equal fitting opportunity; identify the joint frequency/position/domain error type before enlarging the model.
decision_rules.inconclusive: A practical benefit is neither supported nor excluded; nonsignificance is not evidence that context is unnecessary.
decision_rules.neither_improves: If neither enrichment nor extra context materially narrows the same-panel A1+A2 gap, use the remaining joint error patterns and fitting diagnostics to propose a different objective or inverse-mechanism test, not an unbounded training expansion.
